## Media enquiries

I am happy to help journalists, podcast hosts and organisers with background, interviews or talks, in Danish or English. Topics I can speak on:

- Depression and its treatment, including who benefits from which antidepressant
- Side effects of antidepressants, such as sexual side effects and emotional blunting
- Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), the menstrual cycle and mood
- Hormonal contraception and mental health
- Brain imaging and EEG in psychiatry
- Psychedelics in psychiatric research

**How to reach me.** Contact details are on my [NRU profile](https://nru.dk/index.php/about-us/staff-list/95-postdocs/288-kristian-reveles-jensen). Please include your outlet, deadline and the angle you are working on. I answer clinical and research questions in general terms and cannot comment on individual patients.

**Talks.** I regularly speak at continued education meetings for practising psychiatrists, gynaecologists and midwives, and can be booked for talks to professional and public audiences.
